_comment: Завдання NPC у стилі Stoneshard (D162, D175): видав → умова → нагорода. Стан — прапорці task_<id>_taken / task_<id>_done. after — id завдання, після якого це відкривається. gives/needs/reward — {item_id: кількість}; needs лише показують, не забирають; needs_flag — прапорець, без якого не здати (D293). description — передісторія для Журналу, objective — що зробити (D311). location — локація з locations.json, під якою завдання стоїть у Журналі (D181).

tasks.title: The Stolen Caravan
tasks.description: The bandits Kusakam is chasing robbed a merchant's caravan on the Desert Road and drove it to the City Gates. The merchant follows his goods to the City.
tasks.objective: Drive the bandits from the City Gates, then find the Merchant in the City, just past the gates

tasks.title: The Helmet
tasks.description: The City's blacksmith saw what the bandits' maces left of the gate guards. He will not sell Kusakam a helmet: one you forged yourself sits better than one you bought. His word holds like a contract before the god of deals: show him the finished helmet and he pays back every coin it cost.
tasks.objective: Buy 2 Iron Ingots and 1 Leather from the Merchant past the City gates, forge an Iron Helmet at the Blacksmith's anvil (12 coins), then show it to the Blacksmith

tasks.title: The Enchantment
tasks.description: The Blacksmith hands Kusakam two Iron Swords to learn enchanting on.
tasks.objective: Enchant the two Iron Swords into an Iron Sword +1 and show it to the Blacksmith

tasks.title: The Humble Place
tasks.description: Malik, a talkative merchant from the last cell, swore that his humble place holds gold for everyone who leads him out of the Laboratory. Nobody asked whether they agreed: he simply follows, quiet as a shadow.
tasks.objective: Lead Malik out of the Laboratory
